$comment: Master authored-character catalog (spec §2 checklist). 19 designs, permanent kebab ids, no element, no 4-stat blob, no intrinsic rarity -- a monster's rarity is rolled per instance at mint, never a property of the design. Each entry embeds its 3 authored standard moves + one Mana Special + baseMana (usable only when the instance is Epic+). Move shape is schemas/monster.ts moveSchema: power is a 0-10 multiplier for BaseDamage, accuracy/statusChance are percents, manaCost is 0 on standards. Status vocabulary lives in data/attacks.ts. Invariants enforced in data/roster.ts.

characters.name: Broccoli Bud
characters.bio: Turns up to every meal early and leaves last. Bud has never won a fight quickly, but it has finished an awful lot of them.

moves.name: Sprout Jab
moves.description: A brisk headbutt from the smallest floret on the team.

moves.name: Verdant Slam
moves.description: A headbutt with the structural integrity of a cruciferous vegetable.

moves.name: Root Guard
moves.description: Digs in and lets the fight come to it.

special.name: Canopy Crush
special.description: The whole garden lands on the opponent at once.

characters.name: Carrot Cadet
characters.bio: Insists it can see in the dark and volunteers for every night patrol. Nobody has been able to prove otherwise, which Cadet considers proof.

moves.name: Night Patrol Jab
moves.description: Strikes where it cannot see. Allegedly.

moves.name: Vita Flash
moves.description: A blinding beta-carotene flare.

moves.name: Recon Rations
moves.description: Eats its own supplies mid-fight.

special.name: Midnight Recon
special.description: Reports back with the opponent's weaknesses, violently.

characters.name: Water Droplet
characters.bio: The squadmate nobody picks and everybody misses. Droplet asks for nothing and quietly decides how long the rest of the team lasts.

moves.name: Splash
moves.description: Unremarkable. Until you go without.

moves.name: Undertow
moves.description: Pulls the fight down to its level.

moves.name: Mist Veil
moves.description: Becomes briefly ungraspable.

special.name: Riptide
special.description: The polite way to drown someone.

characters.name: Bean Sprout
characters.bio: Barely a week old and already picking fights with vegetables twice its size. Sprout wins more of them than the odds allow.

moves.name: Quick Jab
moves.description: Lands before anyone notices it swung.

moves.name: Underdog Uppercut
moves.description: Hits harder than anything that size should.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: Pure protein confidence.

special.name: Sprout Surge
special.description: One week of growth, delivered in a single punch.

characters.name: Spinach Scout
characters.bio: Collapses at the first sign of heat and is back on its feet before anyone can check on it. The team has stopped worrying; Scout has not stopped collapsing.

moves.name: Leaf Slap
moves.description: More dignity in the slap than in the scout.

moves.name: Iron Rebound
moves.description: Collapses, then returns the hit with interest.

moves.name: Play Dead
moves.description: Wilts dramatically. Recovers instantly.

characters.name: Almond Knight
characters.bio: Arrived already wearing the armour and has never taken it off. Whatever the Knight looks like underneath is a matter of speculation.

moves.name: Nut Crack
moves.description: Armour meeting armour.

moves.name: Shellbreaker
moves.description: Ending badly for one of them.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: The shell was already there. Now it is more so.

special.name: Armour Press
special.description: The full weight of the shell, applied deliberately.

characters.name: Salmon Striker
characters.bio: Insists it can see in the dark and disagrees with the current. Striker chooses the hardest route available on every single occasion.

moves.name: Scale Slap
moves.description: A wet, contemptuous slap.

moves.name: Upstream Rush
moves.description: Charges directly into whatever current the fight is running.

moves.name: Spawning Drive
moves.description: Homeward fury.

special.name: Leaping Falls
special.description: Clears the waterfall and the opponent in one jump.

characters.name: Avocado Aegis
characters.bio: Spends most of its life not quite ready and then, briefly, is the best defender on the field. Timing the Aegis is the entire skill.

moves.name: Pit Toss
moves.description: Dense. Surprisingly aerodynamic.

moves.name: Smash Ripe
moves.description: The eleven minutes are now.

moves.name: Eleven-Minute Wall
moves.description: Becomes briefly immovable.

characters.name: Kale Colossus
characters.tagline: Nobody asked for it. It came anyway.
characters.bio: Appeared one season without invitation and simply would not leave. The Colossus is now the largest thing in the garden and mentions it often.

moves.name: Frond Whip
moves.description: A leaf the size of a sail.

moves.name: Gardenquake
moves.description: The largest thing in the garden lands on you.

moves.name: Photosynthesise
moves.description: Stands in the light and repairs itself.

special.name: Overgrowth
special.description: The garden expands until the fight is inside it.

characters.name: Chia Chieftain
characters.bio: Small, patient, and considerably larger than it was an hour ago. The Chieftain has never lost a siege, only outlasted one.

moves.name: Seed Spit
moves.description: A single seed, delivered at speed.

moves.name: Siege Expansion
moves.description: Fills every gap in the defence, then all of yours.

moves.name: Hydrogel Bulwark
moves.description: Expands into the incoming hit.

special.name: Absorb All
special.description: Takes on the weight of everything thrown at it.

characters.name: Pomegranate Paladin
characters.bio: Carries its entire treasury inside its own armour and will open for no one. Cracking the Paladin has ruined a great many kitchens.

moves.name: Aril Shot
moves.description: One ruby, spent.

moves.name: Ruby Barrage
moves.description: Opens the treasury for exactly one volley.

moves.name: Vault Wards
moves.description: The armour seals itself.

special.name: Sealed Treasury
special.description: A thousand rubies, spent at once.

characters.name: Turmeric Titan
characters.bio: Every surface the Titan has ever crossed still bears the mark. It considers this a signature rather than a problem.

moves.name: Root Smash
moves.description: A rhizome the size of a fist.

moves.name: Golden Stain
moves.description: Marks the target. Permanently.

moves.name: Curcumin Guard
moves.description: Anti-inflammatory, anti-your-attack.

characters.name: Spirulina Wyrm
characters.tagline: Older than the lakes it sleeps in.
characters.bio: Was here before the water was, and will be here after. The Wyrm surfaces roughly once a generation and nobody agrees on why.

moves.name: Algae Lash
moves.description: The lake's patience, withdrawn.

moves.name: Ancient Bloom
moves.description: Surfaces for the first time this generation.

moves.name: Still Water
moves.description: Sinks below the fight for a moment.

special.name: Primordial Depths
special.description: The lake remembers being an ocean.

characters.name: The First Seed
characters.tagline: No record of where it came from.
characters.bio: There is no entry for the Seed in any almanac, no season it belongs to, and no second one. Only that it is yours now, and that everything else grew from something like it.

moves.name: Taproot
moves.description: The first root still holds.

moves.name: Genesis Bloom
moves.description: Everything else grew from something like this.

moves.name: Dormancy
moves.description: Waits out the current era.

special.name: Origin Pulse
special.description: The thing everything else is a copy of.

characters.name: Tralala Shark
characters.bio: A shark that grew sneakers instead of fins and never looked back. It chants its own name into the arena before every round, and somehow that is the scariest part.

moves.name: Sneaker Stomp
moves.description: Three feet, one stomp, no mercy.

moves.name: Tralala Chant
moves.description: The name echoes until the opponent's guard drops.

moves.name: Fin Slam
moves.description: A fin that should not work on land. Works anyway.

special.name: Full Tralalero
special.description: The complete chant, unleashed at once.

characters.name: Zibra Zubra Zibralini
characters.tagline: Stripes in places stripes should not be.
characters.bio: Nobody has ever read its full name aloud without hesitating, which is exactly how it wins. It gallops sideways, always.

moves.name: Sideways Gallop
moves.description: Arrives from a direction physics did not predict.

moves.name: Stripe Mirage
moves.description: The stripes blur until nothing can be aimed at.

moves.name: Zubra Kick
moves.description: A hind-leg argument, delivered twice.

special.name: Zibralini Stampede
special.description: One zebra becomes a herd nobody consented to.

characters.name: Frigo Camello
characters.tagline: Cold on the outside. Colder on the inside.
characters.bio: A camel that swallowed a refrigerator and kept the humming. It stores grudges in the freezer compartment, next to the peas.

moves.name: Freezer Burn
moves.description: Contact so cold it counts as damage.

moves.name: Hummm
moves.description: The compressor drone lulls the arena.

moves.name: Door Slam
moves.description: Closes on the opponent like a fridge at 3am.

special.name: Defrost Cycle
special.description: Everything stored comes out at once.

characters.name: Bobrini Cocosini
characters.tagline: Half beaver, half coconut, all problem.
characters.bio: It builds dams out of furniture it does not own and throws its own head when cornered. The head grows back. The furniture does not.

moves.name: Coconut Chuck
moves.description: Throws its own head. It is fine. It grows back.

moves.name: Dam Builder
moves.description: Stacks furniture between itself and consequences.

moves.name: Tail Slap
moves.description: A flat, leathery punctuation mark.

special.name: Cocosini Flood
special.description: Breaks every dam at once. The arena is briefly a river.

characters.name: Trippi Troppi
characters.tagline: Three of something. Nobody agrees on what.
characters.bio: The legend says it arrives when a fight has gone on too long and ends it. Witnesses describe three shapes, one shadow, and a smell like ozone and poor decisions.

moves.name: Triplicate Jab
moves.description: One hit lands. The other two are philosophical.

moves.name: Shadow Split
moves.description: Becomes three silhouettes; only one is real.

moves.name: Troppi Slam
moves.description: All three arrive at the same time, on the same target.

special.name: Third Thing
special.description: The unnamed third attack. It has never missed twice.
